data.one_liner: Emojis for Flutter & Dart with Unicode 17.0 support and a powerful String extension
data.what_it_does: Provides an extensive collection of over 5,000 emojis based on Unicode 17.0, along with a powerful String extension to interact with, extract, count, and manipulate emojis in any text. It also includes an Emoji class for inspecting properties like shortcodes, skin tones, hair styles, and classification.
use_when: You need to parse, extract, or count emojis within user-generated text strings.
Your application requires access to emoji metadata, shortcodes (Discord, Github, Slack), and Unicode details.
You want to convert between emoji characters and platform-specific shortcodes.
avoid_when: You are looking for a comprehensive UI picker widget rather than a utility data and string manipulation library.
strengths: Supports over 5,000 emojis updated to Unicode 17.0.
Rich String extension for seamless emoji manipulation and filtering.
Detailed metadata including skin tones, hair styles, categories, and shortcodes.
weaknesses: Does not include built-in UI picker widgets out of the box.
